# P35.6 — Acquisition plumbing and verification harness (ACQ-01)

**Requirement ids:** **I8 R1–R4** (one registry row per publisher+channel;
normalized permanent ids; camera-class technology typing; full
`iso.3166_2` jurisdiction codes), **I8 NEW-1 / NEW-3 / NEW-4 / NEW-5**
(no duplicate dataset rows; reviewed API rate limits; grouped cadence
batches; malformed-id recompute over silent suffixing), **F-330** (the
Part VIII field denylist), **SIG-INGEST-027/028** (compact-vocabulary and
the fail-closed ingestion gate — every generated row stays
`ingestion_permitted=false` until its HG-03 line is answered), **R6**
(first-run-safe scheduling: new triggers created paused).
**Ticket:**
`docs/tickets/266_P35.6__acquisition-plumbing-and-verification-harness.md`
(manifest row 266, Round 11 / P35, sub-round 11B) · **Base:**
`r11/P36.1a-opt-out-register-and-reservation-refusal` (`3a4699c3`) ·
**Branch:** `r11/P35.6-acquisition-plumbing-and-verification-harness` ·
**Production mutations:** none — machinery only: no `ingestion_permitted`
flip (HG-03 is the operator's), no live fetch, no scheduler enablement,
no deployment, no rights decision.

## Why

The Round-11 acquisition plan (`data/acquisition_plan.csv`, 242 source
rows + 61 target rows across 10 grouped batches) needs deterministic,
fail-closed machinery before any live leg exists: a generator that turns
the plan + consolidated candidate sheet into normalized registry rows,
target rows, cadence batches and live dispositions — with every
deduplication, recompute and refusal recorded in the run manifest — plus
the two offline verifiers (`coverage-delta`, `wave-verify`) the wave's
own evidence standard requires. "No unexplained dots. No unexplained
edges. No silent overwrites. No synthetic certainty."

## What ships

- **`ops/src/ops/acq_gen.py` + `sig-ops acq-generate`** — the generator.
  Joins plan rows to candidates, routes each family to its R2 prefix
  (`camreg_`/`dot_511_`/`procportal_`/`statrep_`/`ccops_`/`policy_`/
  `grant_`/`agenda_`/`legis_`), enforces ≤40-char lower-snake ids with
  no mid-token truncation, refuses collisions and ambiguous prefix
  relations, dedupes declared same-as/duplicate and under-registered
  proposals to targets under the existing row (R1/NEW-1), recomputes
  `_2`/`_in` seed suffixes from geography+name (NEW-5), and routes
  `ACQ-nn` cells through `round11_plan.csv` to manifest tickets —
  non-ACQ ownership cells land in `owned_elsewhere` with the recorded
  owner, unresolved ACQ refs are errors, never silent promotes. Run on
  the committed plan: **242 sources, 61 targets, 10 batches, 242
  dispositions, 0 errors** (9 deduped, 8 owned-elsewhere, 6
  pending-kind for unsupported aggregate transports held in the
  manifest, never emitted as broken `[[targets]]`). Re-runs over the
  committed registry **converge** — an idempotent replay reports its
  own earlier emission in `manifest.converged`, never a NEW-1
  self-collision.
- **Generated artifacts (same PR, per the ticket):** +242
  `[sources.*]` rows in `sources.toml` — every row
  `ingestion_permitted=false`, `rights.spdx="UNDETERMINED"`,
  `redistributable=false`, notes carrying plan/candidate provenance;
  +51 `camera_registry_targets.toml` + 10 `dot_511_targets.toml`
  `[[targets]]` (57 ArcGIS + 4 Socrata; `jurisdiction_scheme="iso.3166_2"`
  with full `US-DE`-form codes, `jurisdiction_place` for sub-state,
  explicit `technology` on camera-class rows — never `traffic_camera`
  for ALPR/ATE); +10 `[[batches]]` in `ops/cadence.toml`
  (`r11-layers-*`, `r11-tier2-01..03`, `r11-procurement-01`, …, cron +
  job/scheduler names + `task_timeout="6h"` + paused-first-run notes);
  +242 `[sources.*]` promote rows in `live_dispositions.toml` naming
  each row's `P<n>.<n>` class ticket.
- **`connectors/field_denylist.py` + `data/field_denylist.toml` (F-330)**
  — the tokenized denylist (plate, red-vrm, hotlist, search-reason,
  first/last name, email, phone, address incl. `ADDRESS1`-style
  alphanumeric-boundary normalization) enforced at
  `sig-connectors validate`, at generator target emission, and inside
  `dot_511.registry_targets()` before fetch expansion.
- **`connectors/dot_511.py`** — ArcGIS `out_fields`: an explicit reviewed
  allowlist replaces the wildcard/default query; legacy rows without
  `out_fields` keep prior behavior for compat. `api_allowlist`
  rate-limit (`rate_limit_per_min`) propagation through target
  expansion (NEW-3).
- **`ops/src/ops/scheduled.py` + `ops/gcp/scheduled-ops.sh` (R6)** —
  per-row `task_timeout` on `[[sources]]`/`[[batches]]` (legistar's
  reviewed 3h; R11 batches' 6h; 60m/36h defaults otherwise) and
  `--paused`: every trigger a run *creates* is created then immediately
  paused (create-paused annotation in `--check` mode); an existing
  trigger's state is never altered by the flag; declared-paused
  maintenance rows stay paused.
- **`ops/src/ops/coverage_delta.py` + `ops/coverage_dimensions.toml` +
  `sig-ops coverage-delta`** — committed-snapshot comparison across
  `blind_spot`/`state_tier`/`gl1_city`/`technology_class`/`country`,
  JSON/CSV snapshots, expected-explanation input, plan-derived expected
  cells, JSON/text reports, `--fail-on-unexplained`.
- **`ops/src/ops/wave_verify.py` + `sig-ops wave-verify`** — the §7.7
  harness: registry-row + gate posture, cadence coverage + cron lint,
  fixture/shadow diffs, live-run evidence, idempotence, technology
  typing, jurisdiction, ER/coverage/public-release evidence. Scope is
  generator-derived (`acq_gen.generate()`), so deduped / owned-elsewhere
  / pending-kind rows are judged as what they are — never as missing
  registry rows. `--require machinery` (live-dependent checks stay
  pending, never a false green) vs `--require live` (promotes pending
  to failures).
- **`tasks/acquisition.py`** — the queue join now distinguishes
  `duplicate` (URL collision with a *permitted* homepage — refused) from
  `existing_unpermitted` (collision with a gated ACQ-01 row — the lead
  is improvement/flip work under the registered source pending HG-03,
  never `net_new`, never a second registration).
- **`ops/iam_identities.toml`** — `expected_job_count` 88 → 98: the ten
  `sig-ingest-r11-*` batch jobs the cadence file now declares (created
  paused) resolve through the existing `ingest` class.
- **`web/src/lib/jurisdictions.ts`** — +26 `iso.3166_2` names
  (`US-AL`…`US-WA`, `AU-TAS`, `AU-WA`) for the codes the generated
  targets emit (R4 full codes); additive to the P34.14 lookup.
- **Tests** — `tests/connectors/test_field_denylist.py` (F-330
  archetypes incl. `ADDRESS1`), `test_dot_511_acq01.py` (out_fields,
  rate-limit propagation, denylist at expansion), extended
  `test_live_dispositions.py` (`P<n>.<n>` class_ticket shape);
  `tests/ops/test_acq_gen.py` (id rules, dedupe, owned-elsewhere,
  pending-kind, convergence), `test_coverage_delta.py`,
  `test_wave_verify.py`, `test_scheduled_ops_acq01.py` (paused planning,
  timeout propagation); updated pins in `test_review_status.py`
  (345 → 587 registered, loadable 236 unchanged),
  `test_iam_job_identities.py` (88 → 98 jobs, 79 → 89 invoker
  bindings), `test_gcp_iac.py` (explicit timeout per batch).

- `uv run python -m ops wave-verify --require machinery` — **598 pass,

## Explicitly NOT done (machinery-only boundary)

No live acquisition, no live verification (`live_verification=false`),
no deployment, no production mutation, no scheduler enablement (new
triggers are created-paused), no `ingestion_permitted` flips, no rights
decisions, no HG-03 answers, no claim-spine writes. Every generated row
is gated until its HG-03 line; no live leg exists.
